_size_1280_overrides.note: Liam 28/10: 14 px text floor at 1280. These sizes are set in px at 1280, not 0.667 × the 1920 value (Godot: theme override by resolution). Batch 1 keys first, then UI-05 B2 keys. Then UI-05 B3 keys (_b3_keys).

_text_sizes: UI-05: 16 / 18 / 24 / 32 / 36, + 28 num_die, 20 num_die_egg, + text_hero 56 (new, banners, boss name, big damage numbers; bigger moments scale 56 by 1.3 in a tween, no 72 size). At 1280 no text is below 14 px (theme override by resolution).

ninepatch.note: UI-06 · NinePatchRect patch margins [left, top, right, bottom] at the 1920 PNG. Ornaments sit inside the corner patches. The crest (crest_<tier>.png, 160×84) is a separate TextureRect centred on the top edge. Canvas px: at 1280 the canvas is scaled 2/3 so margins stay in logical px (TierFrame decides, see TierFrame.gd).
